propositions.name: absolute_translatory_velocity
propositions.quote: referred to axes of (x', y', z') moving through the aether with uniform translatory velocity ( v , 0, 0)
propositions.statement: A material system possesses a definite uniform translatory velocity v through the aether.

propositions.name: common_time_across_two_systems
propositions.quote: the position of each electron in the material medium in motion, at time t , corresponds with that which it would occupy in the medium at rest at time
propositions.statement: There is a common time t in which the position of an electron in the moving medium can be compared to its position in the medium at rest at time t minus vx over c squared.

propositions.name: space_elongation_is_physical
propositions.quote: signifies an elongation of the space of the problem in the ratio
propositions.statement: The transformation of coordinates signifies an elongation of the space of the problem along the direction of the motion of the axes.

propositions.name: physical_contraction_of_moving_matter
propositions.quote: an effect of imparting to a steady material system a uniform velocity of translation is to produce a uniform contraction of the system in the direction of the motion
propositions.statement: Imparting a uniform velocity of translation to a steady material system produces a uniform contraction of the system in the direction of the motion.

propositions.name: molecular_forces_are_electric
propositions.quote: if we assume all molecular forces to be electric forces, motion of a material system through the aether alters its dimensions in a minute but definite manner
propositions.statement: All the internal forces of a material system arise wholly from electrodynamic actions between the electrons that constitute its atoms.

propositions.name: electron_is_singular_point_in_aether
propositions.quote: But this statement implies that the nucleus of the electron is merely a singular point in the aether
propositions.statement: The nucleus of the electron is merely a singular point in the aether with no inertia foreign to the aether.

propositions.name: no_forces_except_through_aether
propositions.quote: that there are no forces between the electrons other than those that exist through the mediation of the aether as here defined, that is other than electric forces
propositions.statement: There are no forces between the electrons except those that exist through the mediation of the aether.

propositions.name: electron_strength_invariant
propositions.quote: motion of a material system containing electrons cannot alter their strengths
propositions.statement: The strength of an electron cannot be altered by the translatory motion of the material system containing it.

propositions.name: electron_strength_is_surface_integral
propositions.quote: the strength of the electron in the moving system is the value of the integral
propositions.statement: The strength of an electron is defined as the value of the surface integral of aethereal vectors taken over a surface surrounding its nucleus.

propositions.name: body_form_from_molecular_forces
propositions.quote: As then the form and the dimensions of a solid body are determined in the last resort by the intensity of the molecular forces
propositions.statement: The form and dimensions of a solid body are determined in the last resort by the intensity of the molecular forces.

propositions.name: translation_alters_electric_action
propositions.quote: the translation of the matter will most likely alter the action between two molecules or atoms in a manner similar to that in which it alters the attraction or repulsion between electrically charged particles
propositions.statement: The translation of matter alters the action between two molecules or atoms in the same manner as it alters the attraction or repulsion between electrically charged particles.

propositions.name: aether_equations_are_linear
propositions.quote: The equations of the free aether, as revealed by MacCullagh's optical analysis, are linear equations
propositions.statement: The equations of the free aether are linear equations.

propositions.name: all_radiations_travel_at_same_speed
propositions.quote: they in fact must be so if all kinds of radiations are to travel with the same speed in the celestial spaces
propositions.statement: All kinds of radiations travel with the same speed in the celestial spaces.

propositions.name: kinetic_energy_from_aethereal_disturbance
propositions.quote: in estimating the mean value of the volume-integral of the square of the aethereal disturbance, which is the total kinetic energy
propositions.statement: The total kinetic energy of a system is the mean value of the volume-integral of the square of the aethereal disturbance.

propositions.name: inertia_is_of_aethereal_origin
propositions.quote: but this is simply asserting that inertia is mainly of electric, or rather of aethereal, origin
propositions.statement: The inertia of a molecule is mainly of electric, or rather of aethereal, origin.

propositions.name: conservation_of_mass_holds_for_electric_mass
propositions.quote: the fundamental chemical law of the constancy of mass throughout molecular transformations is verified for that part of the mass
propositions.statement: The fundamental chemical law of the constancy of mass throughout molecular transformations is verified for that part of the mass that is of electric origin.

propositions.name: gravitation_speed_exceeds_radiation_speed
propositions.quote: The knowledge that the speed of transmission of gravitation, if finite at all, enormously transcends that of radiation
propositions.statement: The speed of transmission of gravitation, if finite at all, enormously transcends that of radiation.

propositions.name: doppler_effect_from_time_change
propositions.quote: The change of the time variable, in the comparison of radiations in the fixed and moving systems, involves the Doppler effect on the wave-length
propositions.statement: The change of the time variable between the fixed and moving systems involves the Doppler effect on wave-length.

propositions.name: null_method_yields_null_earth_motion_effect
propositions.quote: As optical measurements are usually made by the null method of adjusting the apparatus so that the disturbance vanishes
propositions.statement: Because optical measurements are made by the null method of adjusting the apparatus so the disturbance vanishes, there is a general absence of effect of the Earth's motion up to the second order.

propositions.name: michelson_negative_result_included
propositions.quote: The second term in this expression is the Fresnel effect, and the remaining term is its second order correction on our hypothesis which includes Michelson's negative result
propositions.statement: The second-order correction to the Fresnel effect derived on this hypothesis includes Michelson's negative result.

propositions.name: conductor_structure_unchanged_by_current
propositions.quote: the mechanical structure of a conductor is not sensibly affected when it carries a current
propositions.statement: The mechanical structure of a conductor is not sensibly affected when it carries a current.

propositions.name: current_same_in_matter_or_aether_frame
propositions.quote: the specification of that current with reference to moving matter is just the same as with reference to the stationary aether
propositions.statement: The specification of the current of conduction with reference to moving matter is just the same as with reference to the stationary aether.
